text:
Houston Stadium — a wɔfrɛ no NRG Stadium, na ɛfiri Reliant Stadium — wɔyɛɛ no ma rodeo ne football. Wɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ March 9, 2000, wɔwiee no wɔ October 2001, na wɔwiee adan no wɔ abosome 30 mu wɔ sika US$352 million. Ɛdaa mu wɔ August 24, 2002 wɔ preseason game, Miami Dolphins dii Houston Texans 24–3; regular-season NFL game a ɛdi kan no dii September 8, 2002, Texans dii Dallas Cowboys 19–10.

Beaeɛ no nnoɔma a ɛda adi ne engineering: ɛyɛ NFL beaeɛ a ɛdi kan a wɔde retractable roof bɛyɛɛ. Fabric panels mmienu na ɛpae wɔ 50-yard line na ɛbue wɔ sima 7 mu, na Populous (HOK Sport) ne Walter P Moore ne Uni-Systems na wɔyɛɛ no kinetic-architecture ho. Dual-purpose no nyɛ adeɛ a wɔde too akyi — co-tenant Houston Livestock Show ne Rodeo, RodeoHouston, na ɛyɛɛ adwene no mu, na wɔyɛɛ adan no ma nnipa baanu no.

Sɛ Houston Texans fie a ɛdi kan a, stadium no wɔ club seats boro 7,000 ne luxury suites 186, na capacity a ɛda hɔ yɛ 72,220 a ɛtumi kɔ 80,000 akyi ma events akɛseɛ. Ne field no asesa mfeɛ no mu, efi natural-grass tray system a ɛdaa mu no kɔ permanent artificial turf a wɔde too mu wɔ 2015. Ne din nso asesa: ɛdaa mu sɛ Reliant Stadium, ɛbɛyɛɛ NRG Stadium wɔ 2014 wɔ NRG Energy naming rights, na ɛtoo edin Houston Stadium ma 2026 World Cup, na Reliant din no bɛsan aba akyiri.

Efi football ne rodeo akyi no, adan no agye nneɛma akɛseɛ wɔ ɔman no mu: Super Bowls XXXVIII ne LI, 2024 College Football Playoff National Championship, ne WrestleMania 25. 2026 World Cup no yɛ ne men’s World Cup a ɛdi kan, ne chapter a ɛdi akyiri ma beaeɛ a versatility ne scale na ɛma no da adi.
